{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Ccyw5KMsdp7Yk6625yyPu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01L4TJCyL9sj2nLWt3VkRAo9","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"import re\nfrom decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal\n\nimport pandas as pd\n\nEMPLOYEES_PATH = \"/app/dataset/employees.csv\"\nTASKS_PATH = \"/app/dataset/tasks.csv\"\nTIMESHEET_PATH = \"/app/dataset/timesheet.csv\"\n\n\ndef _round_half_up(value: float) -> int:\n    return int(Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal(\"1\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))\n\n\ndef _parse_task_ids(raw: str) -> list[int]:\n    # performed_tasks can have malformed brackets (missing \"[\" or \"]\"),\n    # so extract digit groups directly instead of relying on literal_eval.\n    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(r\"\\d+\", raw)]\n\n\ndef answer() -> dict[str, list[int]]:\n    employees = pd.read_csv(EMPLOYEES_PATH, dtype={\"PESEL\": str})\n    tasks = pd.read_csv(TASKS_PATH)\n    timesheet = pd.read_csv(TIMESHEET_PATH, dtype={\"employee_id\": str})\n\n    hourly_rate = dict(zip(employees[\"PESEL\"], employees[\"hourly_rate\"]))\n    task_pay = dict(zip(tasks[\"task_id\"].astype(int), tasks[\"pay_per_completion\"]))\n    valid_pesels = set(employees[\"PESEL\"])\n\n    # Drop exact duplicate timesheet entries (same record logged twice under\n    # different ids).\n    timesheet = timesheet.drop_duplicates(\n        subset=[c for c in timesheet.columns if c != \"id\"]\n    )\n\n    # Some employee_id values are corrupted PESELs where two digits were\n    # transposed/scrambled (same digit multiset as a real employee). Correct\n    # them to the matching employee; drop rows with no match at all.\n    def correct_employee_id(eid: str):\n        if eid in valid_pesels:\n            return eid\n        for candidate in valid_pesels:\n            if sorted(eid) == sorted(candidate):\n                return candidate\n        return None\n\n    timesheet[\"employee_fixed\"] = timesheet[\"employee_id\"].apply(correct_employee_id)\n    timesheet = timesheet.dropna(subset=[\"employee_fixed\"])\n\n    # bonus/salary_amount columns in the timesheet are unreliable (don't\n    # match hours*rate or task payouts), so bonuses are recomputed from\n    # performed_tasks against tasks.csv, ignoring task ids that don't exist.\n    def bonus_for_row(raw_tasks: str) -> float:\n        return sum(task_pay.get(tid, 0) for tid in _parse_task_ids(raw_tasks))\n\n    timesheet[\"bonus_calc\"] = timesheet[\"performed_tasks\"].apply(bonus_for_row)\n    timesheet[\"billing_month\"] = timesheet[\"date\"].str.slice(0, 7)\n    timesheet[\"rate\"] = timesheet[\"employee_fixed\"].map(hourly_rate)\n    timesheet[\"row_total\"] = (\n        timesheet[\"hours_worked\"] * timesheet[\"rate\"] + timesheet[\"bonus_calc\"]\n    )\n\n    monthly_totals = (\n        timesheet.groupby([\"employee_fixed\", \"billing_month\"])[\"row_total\"]\n        .sum()\n        .reset_index()\n    )\n\n    result: dict[str, list[int]] = {}\n    for pesel in employees[\"PESEL\"]:\n        rows = monthly_totals[monthly_totals[\"employee_fixed\"] == pesel].sort_values(\n            \"billing_month\"\n        )\n        result[pesel] = [_round_half_up(v) for v in rows[\"row_total\"]]\n\n    return result\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1509,"cache_read_input_tokens":63615,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1509,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c3694aed-9dd5-47a3-ace6-c30ece40dc63","uuid":"35a8ed2e-4e7e-413b-9bf5-df6095e52764","request_id":"req_011Ccyw5GTW99VBxpks7DwQo"}
